ui.policy: Use the final per-source crop boxes, one-pass LANCZOS and canonical masks; small is 70 percent. Preserve setting-atlas geometry and all master rows outside the explicit Lich leaves.

motion.policy: Three character motion bundles remain effective345 bytes; Lich is losslessly trimmed and packed from author clips. Source neutral_back is editor-only. Native special_land stays pass; author runtimeSpeed is not baked into holds. Preserve normal nonvisual event offsets and special nonvisual tracks.

fx.darkWitchPolicy: 22 editable foreground/background layers are already composited into 11 author motion selectors; no duplicate FX overlay.

mech.policy: Endpoint sampling round(i*229/59). Every channel remains visible; 170 intermediate states are not displayed separately. Retain current author y-80; do not adopt offset alternatives or s6 comparison. Direct60, Zone, member-back consumer and all coupled DSL fields remain unchanged.

lich.policy: Adopt fixed Zone-centered 10-FX scene; exclude actor. Preserve original Direct90, end32..50, nonvisual events, sound clock and removal tick110. Fixed geometry does not guarantee exact bounds for every runtime Zone or arbitrary caster position; member snake/per-enemy string are retained.
